title: 2024 Bianchi Sprint custom!

takeaways.text: The 2024 Sprint was offered only as complete bikes (105 mechanical or 105 Di2), not as a frameset, in Celeste or white; he bought the 105 Di2 version and swapped in SRAM Red, a different bar and a 27.2 mm seatpost.
He runs 30 mm rear and 28 mm front clincher tires with 160 mm rotors front and rear.
The 105 Di2 bike cost about C$3,500 online plus roughly C$500–600 import fees; his modified build weighs about 7.2–7.3 kg with pedals and cages, not representative of the stock bike.

disclosure: Owner video; he bought the bike from an online retailer and no sponsorship is stated.
summary: An owner's heavily customized 2024 Bianchi Sprint ICR bought as a 105 Di2 complete bike; the stock build was largely replaced.
